device.name: Spider Farmer GGS Grow Light Controller
device.notes:
BLE grow light controller for Spider Farmer LED grow lights. Marketed as requiring a cloud app but actually uses a simple local BLE protocol with (on older firmware) unencrypted JSON telemetry. $30-50. Companion app: Android com.sf.meizhi / iOS id 6476436750 ("Spider Farmer") — an ODM white-label app.
PROTOCOL: device advertises with name "SF-GGS-CB"; GATT service UUID is 0x00FF (both working codebases — ggs_ble.py in the cited cr0ssn0tice repo and smurfy/esphome-spiderfarmer_ble; only the cr0ssn0tice README table says 0xFF00). Device continuously streams JSON telemetry notifications on characteristic 0xFF01. Commands are sent as JSON write requests on 0xFF02.
FIRMWARE QUALIFIER: unencrypted JSON holds for controller FW <= 3.2 (and PS5 1.7 / PS10 2.9 / LC 1.5). Controller FW 3.14 encrypts BLE payloads with AES-CBC (key/IV per product/firmware, unpublished) and this spec is largely invalid there — the community advises staying on FW <= 3.2 if local BLE matters.
TELEMETRY (notify on 0xFF01): JSON wrapped in a method envelope — {"method":"getDevSta","code":200,"data":{...}} where data is: ``` {"sensor":{"temp":25.4,"humi":55.2,"vpd":1.2},
 "fan":{"level":3,"on":1},
 "blower":{"level":0},
 "light":{"level":100,"on":1}}
``` - temp: temperature in °C - humi: relative humidity in % - vpd: vapor pressure deficit - fan.level: fan speed level - light.level: dimming level (0-100) - light.on: light power state (0/1)
COMMANDS (write JSON to 0xFF02): - Get status: `{"method":"getDevSta"}` - Set light: `{"method":"setLight","data":{"on":1,"level":50}}` - Set fan: `{"method":"setFan","data":{"on":1,"level":N}}` (level 0-10) - Set blower: `{"method":"setBlower","data":{"modeType":0,"on":1,"level":N}}` (level 0-100) - Also observed (pre-encryption firmware): getSysSta (device id + FW/HW
  versions), getConfigFile, setMode, setOnOff, setDevTimezone,
  setDevActive / setDevDeactive
- on: 0=off, 1=on; light level: 0-100
DISCOVERY: name "SF-GGS-CB" is the only confirmed signal (whether a service UUID is present in the advertisement is unverified). Exact-match on "SF-GGS-CB" covers only the controller; the family also includes SF-GGS-PS5 / SF-GGS-PS10 power strips and the SF-GGS-LC light controller, so an "SF-GGS-" prefix match would cover the family. No pairing or bonding required.
Notifications carry a structured 20-byte vendor frame header (per smurfy/esphome-spiderfarmer_ble parse_data()), not "Espressif fragmentation garbage": magic 0xAAAA0003, payload size, msgtype (0x0001 = plaintext JSON, 0x0002 = AES-encrypted), CRC-16 of the total payload, total size, block offset, block size, then block data and a trailing CRC-16; fragmentation/reassembly is a vendor protocol layer. The ESP32 MQTT bridge example at github.com/cr0ssn0tice/Spider-Farmer-GGS-Controller-MQTT accumulates fragments into a buffer and parses when `fan"` and `}}` are both present.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH for service/characteristic UUIDs (0x00FF/0xFF01/0xFF02), JSON telemetry format, getDevSta and setLight commands — sourced from the Python BLE control script (ggs_ble.py) and ESP32 MQTT bridge (Arduino sketch), corroborated by smurfy/esphome-spiderfarmer_ble; applies to FW <= 3.2 only (LOW for current encrypted firmware). MEDIUM: write format for fan/brightness/on/off fully confirmed. LOW: scheduling/timer commands.

credentials.notes: Cloud-free local protocol. Marketed cloud dependency is unused by the local BLE path.

steps.expect: Device powers on and advertises as SF-GGS-CB.

methods.description: Scan for "SF-GGS-CB", connect, subscribe to 0xFF01 notifications. Write JSON commands to 0xFF02.

steps.action: Scan for exact name "SF-GGS-CB" or 0x00FF service and connect.
Subscribe to notifications on 0xFF01 and buffer/parse JSON.

setup.notes: No provisioning. Device advertises as "SF-GGS-CB". Subscribe to 0xFF01 for JSON telemetry. Write commands to 0xFF02.

rejoin.notes: No bonding. Any central can connect.

characteristics.name: Notify
characteristics.notes: JSON telemetry stream, wrapped: {"method":"getDevSta","code":200, "data":{...}}. Device sends fragmented JSON packets behind a 20-byte 0xAAAA0003 vendor frame header (msgtype 0x0001 plaintext / 0x0002 AES-CBC on FW 3.14+). Buffer and accumulate until valid JSON with "fan" and "}}" is complete. Telemetry data includes: sensor (temp, humi, vpd), fan (level, on), blower (level), light (level, on).

characteristics.name: Write
characteristics.notes:
Command channel. Write JSON strings: - Status: `{"method":"getDevSta"}` - Set light: `{"method":"setLight","data":{"on":1,"level":50}}` - Set fan: `{"method":"setFan","data":{"on":1,"level":N}}` (0-10) - Set blower: `{"method":"setBlower","data":{"modeType":0,"on":1,"level":N}}` (0-100) - Also observed (FW <= 3.2): getSysSta, getConfigFile, setMode,
  setOnOff, setDevTimezone, setDevActive/setDevDeactive
Use write_with_response (GATT write request) for reliability.
